title: Natural History of SMA
official: Natural History of SMA: Long Term Longitudinal Study and Development of a Registry
summary: This is an investigator initiated observational study with the aim to record several aspects of function, care and adverse events in a large cohort of SMA patients followed longitudinally by using a structured academic disease registry.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

all patients
